query:
SELECT m.id, m.name, EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM consumer_meal_preferences p
             WHERE p.meal_id = m.id
               AND p.preference = 'dislike'
               AND p.consumer_id = ANY($1::bigint[])
           ) AS "disliked_by_attendee!"
         FROM meals m
         WHERE m.active
         ORDER BY m.name COLLATE "C"
